HushGram still patches Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, so you patch the same way as last time. Most of this release came from you: 57 of the changes below started with one of your reports or requests. You can blur a chat behind a message you're holding, record calls, lock a collection right from Saved, keep the tab bar on reel links and hide comments that use your blocked words. There are 44 fixes too.

Fixes

- With `Glass tab bar` and `Show content behind the tab bar` on, a story you open no longer covers the whole screen for a moment before jumping up above the gesture bar. Reported in #618.

- Unticking Interested or Not interested in `Items in the three-dot menus` takes them off a suggested post's menu in Home again. Instagram 456 renamed those two rows there. Reported in #707.

- The time on a feed video's seek bar is smaller now and sits under the tags and sound buttons, so tapping it no longer opens the tags instead. Reported in #711.

- The dot beside a new setting stays until you've scrolled to it. Going back out of a page cleared every dot on it, even the ones further down you never saw. Reported in #689.

- `Show if a profile follows you` now labels profiles that have a name but no pronouns. The label and badges were only showing up on profiles with no name at all. Reported in #727.

- `Ambient light in stories` no longer flashes white bars on a light theme when a story opens or you swipe to the next one. The glow also stays on until the next story's is ready. Reported in #751.

- `Long press a profile picture to view it` works on accounts with an avatar too. Their picture turns between the photo and the avatar, and a long press there used to open Instagram's avatar card instead of the picture. Reported in #758.

- Posts with several photos and a song keep their seek bar in the reels viewer now, the same as a single photo with a song. Reported in #10.

- `See-through top bar` fades out below the header now, instead of stopping on a hard line when you scroll back up. Reported in #462.

- Home no longer crashes when a hide switch removes the only post on a page of the feed, which could happen when opening a link to a post.

- With `Ask for VP9 instead of AV1` on, a post or reel Instagram still sends as AV1 saves as VP9 from its website when one's there. HushGram asks logged out. Stories can still come as AV1. Reported in #546.

- Letting go after `Hold for 2x on feed videos` no longer pauses the video when `Tap a feed video to pause it` is on too.

- The tags and sound buttons on feed videos move up above the seek bar while it shows, carousel videos' sound button too, so they don't cover its ends. The toggle sits beside them. Reported in #794.

- An exported settings file now keeps `Time on the seek bar` and `Show the time left` for feed videos too.

- The `Show if a profile follows you` label no longer lands on top of the post count on profiles with no name.

- `Glass in chats` keeps the message bar's glass when Instagram switches the bar to its newer layout, and `Message bar tint` works on it again. Reported in #759.

- Messages in a chat no longer jump and snap back while you type a long message with `Glass in chats` on. Reported in #757.

- `Fill the screen` goes grey with a line saying why while `Show the whole reel` is on, since that switch wins and reels kept their side bars. Reported in #755.

- `Hide captions` no longer leaves an empty gap under the username on reels. The username row moves down into the caption's room. Reported in #680.

- The seek bar on reels no longer sits under the floating tab bar after you come back from picture in picture. Reported in #450.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.6.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `456.0.0.53.78`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

This one moves to Facebook 588.0.0.42.55 and needs Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer, so update Manager and grab the new Facebook APK before you repatch. Every patch now goes in on the Android 9 and 10 build too. There's a lot new here. The next reel can play in the background, groups can keep the tab bar, and a tap on a feed video can bring up a pause button instead of opening Reels. Stories can lose their reply bar and Up next card, Facebook can go through a proxy you name (handy for VLESS), and a tablet can keep the feed in a column down the middle. On the fix side, reels fit the screen on a tablet held sideways and behind see-through bars, and `Play saved videos in a row` no longer stops on a saved post or shakes between videos. The tab bar also comes all the way back when you scroll to the top, and on Android 17 a close for using too much memory leaves a crash file and counts toward safe mode.

New in this release

- `Next reel in the background` under Video and audio, for use with `Keep playing in the background`. When a reel playing in the background ends, the next reel Reels had loaded plays instead of the same one again, and you come back to Facebook on the last one played. Facebook doesn't load more reels while it's in the background, so once those run out the last one plays again. It starts off. (#524)

- `Keep the tab bar in groups` in the tab bar settings. Facebook opens a group on a page of its own with no tab bar, so the only way to another tab was Back. With this on, a group keeps the tab bar along the bottom, and tapping a tab takes you straight there. It works while the tab bar is at the bottom and starts off. (#503)

- `Show reactions on the Like button` under News feed moves a post's reaction icons from the far end of the row under it onto the Like button, right before the count, the way the summary line used to read. The button still likes and reacts like before. A video that shows its views there gets one Like icon, or your own reaction once you react. It starts off, and `Hide the reaction preview on posts` wins when both are on. (#541)

- `Tap shows a pause button on feed videos` under Video and audio stops a tap from opening a feed video in Reels. The tap brings up a big play/pause button in the middle of the video and the video keeps playing. Tap the button to pause or play, or tap the video again while it shows to open it. It starts off, and with Tap to play on it needs Inline feed video controls on too. (#538)

- `Hide the live video comment bar` under Comments and writing takes the comment box and the row of reactions off the bottom of a live video, so a stray tap won't send a reaction or open the keyboard. The live comments stay. It starts off. (#537)

- `Ignore taps beside the buttons` under News feed keeps a tap on the empty part of the row under a post, between the buttons and the reaction icons, from opening the comments or who reacted. Handy when you're aiming for a video's seek bar just above. It starts off. (#540)

- `Hide the Follow button` under Stories takes Follow off the top of a story from someone you don't follow. It starts off. (#543)

- `Hide the reply bar` under Stories takes the bar off the bottom of other people's stories, so the repost button, the Send message box and the quick reactions can't be tapped by accident. It starts off. (#542)

- `Hide the Up next card` under Stories starts the next stories right away, without the Up next card counting down over the first one. It starts off. (#544)

- New `Drag along the bottom edge` under Video and audio, for `Thin line seek bar`. While you drag the thin line it stays on the video's bottom edge, a bit thicker, with the time in the middle above it, instead of rising into the full bar. It starts off. (#539)

- `Hide posts with words you choose` and `Hide link posts` each have a switch for every place they reach (Home, the Reels tab, groups, profiles and Pages, and now search results). The first four start on, so nothing changes until you turn one off, and then that place keeps its posts while the others still lose theirs. Search results start off, since you usually want to see what you searched for. Turn it on and the posts on the Posts tab and in All go by your words or links too. (#458)

- `Ask before reacting to a story` under Stories makes a tap on a reaction at the bottom of a story ask "React to this story?" first. The story pauses while the question is up, and only Continue sends the reaction. Cancel, Back or a tap outside sends nothing and the story plays on. It's part of `Ask before a like` and starts off. (#502)

- `Hide friends' reactions on photos and videos` under News feed takes away the little picture of a friend with their reaction on it that Facebook puts in the corner of a photo or video someone you know reacted to. It's off until you turn it on. (#483)

- `Hide who reacted under posts` under News feed takes away the line under a post that names a friend or Page who reacted, like "Name and others reacted". It's off until you turn it on. (#483)

- `In-app proxy` under Privacy sends Facebook's connections through an HTTP proxy you name, like `127.0.0.1:10808`. A VLESS or V2Ray app's local port works there (v2rayNG's is `127.0.0.1:10808`), so Facebook can go through VLESS without the whole phone on a VPN. Leave it blank and Facebook connects the way your phone does. [Help](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/help.md#facebook-through-vless-or-another-proxy) walks through setting it up. (#504)

- `Ask before downloading` under Downloads puts a Continue or Cancel question in front of a reel's Download button, the Download button under a post and a video's `Download to phone`. It starts off. (#511)

- `Emoji font file` under Appearance lets you pick your own .ttf or .otf emoji font for `Use the phone's emoji`. Facebook needs a restart to pick it up, and a font with no emoji in it gets refused. (#513)

- A video opened from a post with several photos or videos now has `Download to phone` in the three-dot menu at the top. (#509)

- `Back to Clean mode` under Reels and Watch puts a reel back in Clean mode by itself after you bring its buttons back. Pick when: once the comments or a menu you opened close, or after 3, 5 or 10 seconds without touching the screen. It starts on Never. (#519)

- `Hide the line along the tab bar` under Tabs and navigation takes away the thin line Facebook draws along the edge of the tab bar, on every tab. It starts off, and a change shows on the next tab you tap. (#521)

- `Plain slide between people` under Stories turns the cube Facebook plays when you swipe from one person's stories to the next into a flat slide. Facebook only uses the cube on some accounts, and others already get a plain slide or a tilt. It's part of `Clean up the story viewer` and starts off. (#521)

- `Header text font` under Appearance picks the font your `Home header text` words draw in. There's Bold (how they've always looked), Regular, Serif, Script and Monospace, and `Your font` uses the font file you picked under `Font file`, even with `Use the system font` off. Facebook draws the header once, so a change shows after a restart. (#532)

- `Hide New for you on reels` under Reels and Watch takes "New for you", and the other reasons Facebook gives for showing you a reel, off the line under its author. It's part of `Clean up Reels` and starts off. With the label kept and `Show the post date on reels` on, the date now shows first, so you don't wait for the line to turn over to see when the reel was posted. (#520)

- `Translate every comment` under Comments and writing shows Facebook's translation on comments in another language as they load, the same as tapping See translation on each one. It comes with `Turn off auto-translation` and starts off. (#522)

- `Long press to save Marketplace photos` under Downloads saves a Marketplace listing's photo when you hold your finger on it, in the listing or opened full screen. It lands in the same folder as every other photo you save. It needs `Save any photo` and starts off. (#515)

- With `See-through bars` on, the strip behind the clock and battery icons is frosted glass too on Android 12 and newer, so the glass runs from the top bar up to the edge of the screen instead of stopping under a solid band. (#507)

- `Dim to` under Reels and Watch picks how much of a reel's buttons, caption and bars still shows once `Burn-in guard` dims them, from 0 to 100 percent. Left blank it stays at the 25 it always used. `Smooth fade` next to it eases them out and back in instead of switching at once, and it starts off. (#523)

- A crash deep in Facebook's native code or a freeze now leaves a `crash-` file in Download/Hushfacebook too, and so does Android 17 closing Facebook for using too much memory. Facebook writes it the next time it starts, even when that start runs paused, with what closed it and Android's own note about it. A freeze keeps the main thread's part of Android's trace. One from before your last update or reinstall says when that was and marks the versions unknown, since they could be the old build's. Before, only a Java crash got a file. (#528)

- `Video buffer` under Video and audio picks how much of a video loads before it starts and while it plays. Low starts a video once half a second has loaded and keeps less loaded ahead, so it uses less data. Medium waits for 1.5 seconds and Maximum for 3, and both keep more loaded ahead (up to a minute on Maximum), which can help when the connection is slow. It starts at Facebook's choice, which leaves everything as Facebook has it, and a change shows on the video that's playing within a moment. (#526)

- `Recently watched in the Menu` under Menu adds a Recently watched row to Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu, right after Watch history. Tap it and the list `Remember what you watch` keeps opens over the Menu, so you don't have to go through the settings to get back to a reel or video. It needs `Resume long videos` and starts off. (#529)

- `Center the feed on big screens` under Appearance keeps the feed and Facebook's other lists in a column down the middle on a tablet or an unfolded phone, so posts stop stretching from one edge of the screen to the other. Reels still get the whole screen. It starts off. (#531)

- Four new switches for the top of a post, all off until you turn them on. `Show full names` under News feed lets a long name wrap onto a second line instead of ending in "...". `Hide songs under names` leaves the song out of the line under the name, with no gap where it was, and `Bold post times` makes the time or date there bold like the name. `Dark box behind feed video names` under Reels and Watch puts a name drawn on top of a feed video on the same dark box reel names can get. (#533)

Fixes

- With the tab bar at the bottom sliding away as you scroll, the tabs come all the way back when you scroll back to the top. After a short scroll near the top they used to stop short and sit over the gesture bar until you scrolled again. With `Tab bar while scrolling` on `Hides while scrolling`, Home also opens at the top after a restart. Facebook moved the feed down a little a few seconds after it opened, which slid both bars away before you'd touched anything.

- On a tablet or an unfolded phone held sideways, the reels you swipe to on the Reels tab fit the screen, with the caption, buttons and seek bar showing. Facebook works the reel's height out for the screen held upright, so turned on its side the bottom of every reel ran off the screen. (#531)

- `Play saved videos in a row` keeps going past a saved post. When the next card in Saved was a post and not a video, the post opened and the run of videos stopped there. Now that post closes again on its own and the card after it plays, and the screen stays black while it does, so you don't see the post flash by. Posts you open yourself stay open. (#404)

- `Play saved videos in a row` doesn't shake anymore when you swipe to the next or previous saved video. Facebook first shows a new video a little lower and smaller, under the status bar, then jumps it up to fill the screen. Opening one video by hand you barely notice it, but the run opens a new one on every swipe. Now the screen stays black for that moment and the video shows once it's in place. (#404)

- `3-dot menu items to hide` takes Interested, Not interested and Your algorithm off a reel's More sheet now. They sit in a card at the top of that sheet that's built apart from the rest, so ticking them only hid them from posts. Your algorithm is the reel's name for a post's Manage your Feed, so the list calls that row `Manage your Feed / Your algorithm`. Three more reel rows read the way the sheet shows them too: `Quality settings`, `Request community note` and `Something went wrong` were "Best guess post", "Other" and "Bug". (#475)

- `Seek bar on feed videos` gets out of the way while comments are open. On a phone with the three navigation buttons it showed just above them, under the comments. (#535)

- `Times on the seek bar` and `Full length on the seek bar` work with `Thin line seek bar` now. The times sit just above the line's two ends, whether you're dragging or not. Before, the thin line turned them off. (#487)

- `Hide prompts and promos under reels` also takes the "Made with Edits" pill off the corner of a video in your feed now. That pill is a different piece from the line under a reel's caption, so the switch only caught the line. (#314)

- With `Tap the bar to seek` on, the three dots and other buttons that sit just above a reel's progress line open again. Before, a tap on the bottom of the three dots in a saved reel jumped the video instead of opening the menu. A tap on the line itself still seeks.

- A saved reel you open from your library on the Reels tab fits the screen again. Its bottom no longer runs under the comment box, so Facebook's way out of Clear mode is easy to tap.

- With `Show the post date on reels` on, the date under a reel's author stays put. On a reel with a song, the song line no longer scrolls the date out of sight, and on the others the line holds on the date instead of turning over to the location or "New for you" a few seconds later. (#503)

- A Facebook that crashes or gets closed while you're signed out now leaves its `crash-` file too. Before, a start that stayed on the login screen never wrote it. (#528)

- With `Show the post date on reels` on, a reel shows its date once. Facebook is trying out a second date at the end of the caption on some accounts, and that one now stays out while the date under the author shows. (#503)

- With `Keep playing in the background` on, a video playing in the picture-in-picture window keeps its sound when you lock the phone and plays on in the window when you unlock it. (#495)

- With `Open comments at` on `Full height` or `Half height`, Comment on the Reels tab now slides the regular sheet straight up over the reel. Before, the reel shrank into the top of the screen first, the way Facebook's split view opens, and at full height the sheet covered it a moment later. (#501)

- With the tab bar at the bottom and `See-through bars` or `Rounded tab bar` on, a reel's video now runs the whole screen, down under the tab bar and the gesture bar. Its name, caption and buttons sit above the tab bar instead of behind it and move with the reel as you swipe. (#503, #466)

- With the tab bar at the bottom and `See-through bars` on, the Reels tab now runs the reel up behind the status bar too, so the time and battery sit over the video instead of a solid strip. The Reels title and its buttons stay just below the status bar. (#466)

- With `See-through bars` and `Hide the video comment box` on, a reel or video you open from a post runs down under the gesture bar too, instead of stopping above a dark band. Its caption, its buttons, the seek bar and the Up next card sit just above the gesture bar. (#466)

- With the tab bar at the top and `See-through bars` on, the Reels seek bar now sits just above the gesture bar instead of on it, so dragging it doesn't take you to the home screen. (#466)

- `Fold long text` now holds to the number of lines you picked on posts it used to miss, including the first ones in the feed. Comments fold by how they actually wrap on your screen, so 8 lines means 8 lines, with See more on the last of them instead of a line further down. A video's caption follows the count you picked for posts. (#506)

- The download button under a post and the post's menu now find videos that sit behind a photo or inside an album. A post with several videos gets `Save all videos`. (#509)

- Your own story stays first in the tray when `Move seen stories to the end` or a similar switch is on. (#510)

- The progress line on a reel opened from the feed sits above the gesture bar instead of under it. (#469)

- `Hide the tab bar on the Reels tab` no longer leaves a grey line under the Reels title when your tabs are at the top. The line comes back with the bar on the other tabs. (#508)

- `Seek bar on feed videos` stays out of Facebook's own video viewer, so a video you open from the feed only shows Facebook's bar. (#505)

- A long press on a reel's Download, Cast or Clean mode button no longer opens an empty gray box. (#518)

- With `Hide the tab bar on the Reels tab` on, a reel's time, caption and seek bar sit above the gesture bar again, so the seek bar can be tapped and held. (#516)

- With `Tap to play` on, video stories play by themselves again, the way Facebook plays them. Before, the story after the first one, or one you swiped to, could sit frozen at the start, since a tap on a story moves on instead of playing it. Stories that wait for you are what `Video stories wait for a tap` is for. (#521)

- A Threads post in your feed opens that post in Threads instead of the Threads home feed. The 0.23.0 fix missed the redirect link Facebook now sends the card through, which Threads opens on the feed, and Threads' list form of the post number. Both open the post now. (#385)

- With `View stories anonymously` on, a story you watch counts as watched on your phone again, so its ring turns gray and `Hide seen stories` can take it out. Hushfacebook read the wrong flag on the viewer and took every story for a quick peek, so none of them were kept as watched. (#165, #514)

- `Show the post date on reels` now dates a video posted in a group too. Facebook's full screen viewer gives a group's video no date line under its author, so the date goes after the poster's name, like "Ana Lima · 3 weeks ago". (#520)

- With `Hide posts you've already seen` or another switch that hides a lot of the feed, Home fills in by itself when you open Facebook fresh. When the first pages were all posts the switch hides, Home sat on stories, the Reels shelf and its loading row until you swiped, since Facebook only asks for more posts as the feed scrolls. It now asks again on its own a few times, and a swipe still asks too. (#493)

- With `Open feed videos on their own` on, a video you tap after it played for a while in the feed opens alone too. Facebook had already loaded it by then, so the first batch it handed the viewer held only the videos after yours, and the 0.23.0 trim let one of them through. That batch is skipped now. (#457)

- On Android 17, Facebook getting closed for using too much memory in its first minute now counts toward safe mode the way a crash or a freeze does, so three starts in a row that end like that open Facebook with Hushfacebook paused. It only counts while you're using Facebook. A swipe away, a force stop or Android clearing it out in the background still doesn't. (#528)

- Every patch goes in on Facebook's Android 9+ build of 588 (build 707615023) once Hush Unpacker has unpacked it. With 0.23.0 a number of them failed there and had to be unchecked before patching. The README names the bundle to take on Android 9 and 10. (#102, #422)

Other changes

- Hushfacebook now patches Facebook 588.0.0.42.55 and no longer takes 587. On a 64-bit phone download the (arm64-v8a) (120-480dpi) (Android 11+) bundle, build 707615136, and on a 32-bit phone the (arm-v7a) (320dpi) (Android 11+) bundle, build 707615135. Update Facebook before you patch.

- You need Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer now, since the patches are built on Morphe patcher 2.5.0 and older Managers turn the bundle down. Update Manager first. Desktop patching needs morphe-desktop 2.3.0.

- The README is about half as long. The patch list moved to [docs/patches.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/patches.md) and the help topics to [docs/help.md](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/help.md), and the README links to each topic.

- The changelog starts at 0.20.0 now, so Morphe Manager has a lot less to download when it shows what changed. Versions 0.1.0 to 0.19.0 are in the [changelog archive](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/changelog-archive.md), word for word.

- `Hide create story cards` under Stories now also takes out the full screen "continue the story" card, the one asking you to share a recent moment from your gallery with a Create story button. (#521)

- With `Clean mode button on reels` on, Facebook's button for leaving Clean mode now sits right where the sidebar's Clean mode button was, so the same spot turns it on and off. It takes that spot from your last tap on the sidebar button in that viewer. (#391)

- `Hold a feed photo to react` and `Hold a feed video to react` open the reactions right by your finger now, instead of down by the Like button, so there's no long slide to reach one. Once you let go, a tap anywhere off them closes them without reacting. Their `Reaction` list has a new `Slide to pick one` too: slide to a reaction and let go, and letting go anywhere else closes them. (#454)

- The bug form now requires the Facebook file you patched. (#528)

- When a Debug report says why Facebook went away last time, it now names Android 17's two new reasons, the memory limiter and an anomaly, instead of showing a bare number. (#528)

- With `Keep playing in the background` on, a reel you swiped to in Reels keeps its sound after you leave Facebook. Before, only a video you'd started with a tap carried on, so a reel you'd swiped to went quiet. Reels playing in the feed or in a story still stop when you leave. (#524)

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too, and the oldest ones are in its [archive](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/docs/changelog-archive.md).

How to update

This release targets Facebook 588.0.0.42.55.

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.7.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `588.0.0.42.55`. On most phones that's build `707615136`, the arm64-v8a one. Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `707615135`, the armeabi-v7a one.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

## [1.19.0-dev.4](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/compare/v1.19.0-dev.3...v1.19.0-dev.4) (2026-11-19)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

### ✨ New Features

* **flags:** add reels-style create tab and remix hub flags to curated registry and baseline configuration ([16b1112](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/16b1112ceba6a776fcc58e4cc6ec362c0f0760bc))

HushGram now patches Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 and builds on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.6.0 or newer before you patch. All 62 new features in this release came from your requests. You can keep a list of who viewed your stories, search your blocked accounts, give the tab bar a Material look or make Instagram's text bigger. The fix list is a long one too.

New in this release

- A saved profile can sit in more than one folder now. Save profile lists your folders with tick boxes, and a long press in `Your saved profiles` offers `Choose folders`. Settings exports keep every folder. Asked for in #687.

- `Long press a profile picture to view it`, new under Profiles, opens the picture at the top of a profile at full size, with Save under it. A tap still does what it always did. Starts off. Asked for in #737.

- `Download full song`, new under Reels, adds a row under Download on reels and photos with Instagram music. It saves the whole song instead of the reel's clip, and `Ask what to save` offers it too. Starts off. Asked for in #735.

- `Hide the top bar on other reels`, new under Reels, takes the back arrow and title off reels you open from Explore, a profile, a post, Saved or a chat. The back gesture still works. Starts off. Asked for in #680.

- `Search blocked accounts`, new under Ads and privacy, adds a search box to your blocked accounts that finds them by username or name. Long lists load as you type, with a count of matches. Starts off. Asked for in #731.

- `Hide the Messages badge`, new under Tab bar, takes the unread count off the Messages button in the bottom bar. Chats still show as unread in your inbox and notifications still come. It starts off and takes a restart. Asked for in #734.

- `Don't send feed view history`, new under Feed, stops Instagram from learning which Home posts you looked at, like `Don't send reel watch history` does for Reels. Seen posts may come back. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Asked for in #664.

- `Ask for VP9 instead of AV1`, new under Downloads, tells Instagram your phone has no AV1 decoder, so reels and stories come as VP9 or H.264. It helps when AV1 saves won't play in your gallery. Asked for in #546.

- `Keep story viewers`, new under Stories, keeps a list on your phone of who viewed each of your stories. Its page shows who viewed over a week, month or 90 days and who views most. Asked for in #710.

- `Keep online history`, new under Profiles, keeps a list on your phone of when people in your messages came online and went offline, from the active status Instagram already shows. Asked for in #590.

- `Glass lens under your finger`, new in Tab bar, makes the `Liquid glass look` bubble swell and bend what's behind it under your finger. The bend needs `Blur behind the tab bar` and Android 13 or newer. Starts off. Asked for in #705.

- `Cache size limit`, a slider under `Clear the media cache` in Storage, sets how much room Instagram's saved photos and videos can take, from 100 MB to 4,000 MB. It starts at 500 MB like before. Asked for in #713.

- `Save changed pictures to the gallery`, under `Keep profile history` in Profiles, saves both the old and the new picture when a profile you open has changed it. Each picture is saved once. Starts off. Asked for in #715.

- Tap the `Show it as a chip` chip on a profile to see everything else Instagram says about you two, like a pending follow request, Close Friends, Favorites, a restriction, a block, a hidden story or a mute. Asked for in #698.

- `Tabs on your profile` and `Tabs on other profiles` under Profiles can take a creator's Subscriptions tab off too, along with Reels, Reposts and Tagged. Asked for in #721.

- `Hide rings outside the stories row`, under `Story ring size` in Stories, takes the story and live rings off profile pictures on posts, comments, reels and profiles. The pictures stay, and so do the rings in the stories row. Asked for in #719.

- Each number beside a reel can go on its own now. Five new switches under Reels, `Hide like counts on reels` through `Hide save counts on reels`, each take one count away and leave its button. Asked for in #719.

- `Material look`, under Glass tab bar in Tab bar, gives the floating tab bar Android's Material 3 style, a solid round pill in your phone's colors on Android 12 and newer. It needs `Liquid glass look` off. Asked for in #720.

- `Start feed videos muted`, under Feed, keeps videos on Home quiet even after you turn the sound on in Reels, so reels keep theirs. Tap a video's speaker to hear that one. Asked for in #718.

- `Double tap to skip` on Reels flashes arrows and the seconds skipped on the side you tapped, like it already does on feed videos. `Show the skip arrows`, right under it, turns them off. Asked for in #691.

- Quick double taps the same way now add up under the skip arrows on Reels and feed videos, so three skips ahead read 10, 20 and then 30. Asked for in #554.

- `Hide the seek bar on reels`, new under Reels, takes the seek bar off every reel. Drag sideways along a reel's bottom edge to bring it back and seek, even where Instagram turns that off. Needs a restart. Asked for in #680.

- `Hide the pause icon on reels` under Reels keeps a paused reel clear of the big pause icon and its sound button, so the frame you stopped on stays in view. A tap still plays it. Asked for in #686.

- `Hide the Like button on reels` and `Hide the Comment button on reels` under Reels, and `Hide the Like button` under Feed, take those buttons and their counts away. Double tap still likes. Asked for in #668.

- `Ask before a refresh` also asks when you tap Home, Reels or Explore while you're already on it, since that tap scrolls back to the top and reloads too. Cancel leaves the list where it was. Asked for in #655.

- HushGram's own settings screen uses the font you pick in `Change the font` too, headings and switch labels included. Its popups follow it as well, like the "i" descriptions, pickers and PIN prompts. Asked for in #166.

- HushGram speaks Simplified Chinese. Phones set to Simplified Chinese, or to Chinese for China or Singapore, get it instead of English. It's built from the Traditional Chinese table and uses Instagram's own mainland names, like 快拍 and 帖子. Asked for in #659.

- `Double-tap Messages for hidden chats` now shows your hidden chats right in your inbox after your screen lock or PIN, and two more quick taps on Messages hide them again. Long press a chat for Hide chat or Unhide chat. Asked for in #661.

- A new switch, `Hide You may also like in search` under Explore, takes the You may also like posts and their title off the bottom of search results. Accounts and the posts you searched for stay. Asked for in #657.

- `Play only the reel you opened` under Reels keeps a reel you open from a Home post, a suggested reels row or a message on screen, so it loops instead of moving on. The Reels tab scrolls as usual. Asked for in #656.

- `Glass top bar in chats`, new under `Glass in chats` in Messages, takes the frosted band off a chat's top bar while the round glass buttons and message bar keep theirs. It starts on. Asked for in #670.

- `Auto scroll in Home` under Feed moves Home to the next post by itself, when a video ends or after the time you pick for photos and carousels. Touching the screen holds it. Asked for in #660.

- A new switch, `Control the reel above comments` under Reels, lets you tap the reel above open comments to pause or play it, or hold it for 2x. The comments stay open. Starts off. Asked for in #665.

- A new switch, `Classic colors` under Layout, turns dark mode navy blue with charcoal gray panels and light mode off-white, the Messages list included, like Instagram's older look. Story and reel viewers keep their own. Asked for in #639.

- `Swipe left for Messages`, new under Feed, opens Messages when you swipe left across Home, the way Instagram used to. Carousels and the stories row still slide as before. It starts off. Asked for in #639.

- `Hide links`, new with the other profile banner switches under Profiles, takes the row of links (a website or a business's links) from under the bio on other people's profiles. Yours keeps it. Asked for in #627.

- `Send saved GIFs as GIFs`, new under Comments, posts a GIF you saved with `Save comment photo` as a GIF when you pick it from your gallery in a comment. Instagram sent it as a still. Asked for in #402.

- `Hide Blend in chats` and `Hide the back button in chats`, new under Messages, take those buttons off a chat's top bar. Swiping back still leaves the chat. Asked for in #688.

- `Top bar tint in chats` and `Message bar tint`, new under `Glass in chats`, set how dark each glass bar is, from 0% (blur only) to 150%. The tab bar keeps its own tint. Asked for in #688.

- `Header text font` picks bold, regular, serif, script, monospace or your `Font` choice for the words on Home's header, and `Center the header text` puts them in the middle of the screen. Asked for in #688.

- With `Glass in chats` on, messages scroll under a chat's top bar and show through it blurred, and the blur runs up behind the status bar with a soft fade at its edge. Asked for in #684.

- `Story buttons at the bottom`, new under Stories, puts the seen and download buttons at the bottom right of a story, by your thumb, next to Like. Asked for in #647.

- `Text size`, new under `Font`, sets Instagram's text anywhere from 70% to 200% of the phone's size, in any font. Asked for in #682.

- `Profile history` keeps each profile picture at full size. Old pictures open full screen from its page, a long press saves one to your gallery, and every row says when its old value was seen. Asked for in #611.

- `Decline calls that don't ring`, new under Call blocker, declines a call `Who can call you` keeps quiet, the same as tapping Decline, so it doesn't keep ringing on their end. Starts off. Asked for in #578.

- `Locked collections` under Messages locks single collections in Saved with the same unlock as your other locks. The rest of Saved stays open, and saving a post to a locked one never asks. Asked for in #678.

- `Sort reels on profiles`, new under Profiles, puts the arrow next to Reels on every profile so you can sort by Latest or Most viewed where Instagram took that away. Starts off. Asked for in #679.

- `Shorter Active now`, new under Messages, drops Active now a minute after someone leaves, like the website, instead of six and a half minutes. Restart Instagram after turning it on. Starts off. Asked for in #683.

- `Sent follow requests`, new under Profiles, keeps a list of the accounts you've asked to follow that haven't let you in. Tap one to open the profile, where Instagram's Requested button cancels it. Starts off. Asked for in #690.

- With `Glass tab bar` on, a reel's seek bar keeps a little room above the tab bar instead of sitting right on it. The caption and buttons move up with it. Asked for in #187.

- `Hide the speed lock message`, under `Hide the 2x popup` in Reels, keeps Instagram's Locked at 2x speed message off a reel, and the one when the lock ends. The lock still works. Starts off. Asked for in #702 and #552.

- `Remove hidden data from saved photos`, new under Downloads, strips Meta's FBMD tracking tag and camera, place or time details from photos you save. It and `Add the source to saved photos and videos` now go into settings backups. Asked for in #699.

- `Show the skip arrows` now sits under `Double tap to skip on feed videos` in Feed as well. Turn it off and a double tap still skips, with nothing flashing over the video. Asked for in #562.

- `Feed seek bar shape`, under `Seek bar shape` in Feed, gives feed videos their own shape, so the feed can use the thin line while reels and stories keep theirs. Starts on `Same as Seek bar shape`. Asked for in #567.

- `Time on the seek bar` in Feed shows the time played and the length over a feed video's seek bar, like 0:12 / 0:45. Tap it, or turn on `Show the time left`, to count down instead. Starts off. Asked for in #711.

- `Taps on feed videos stay in the feed`, under `Tap a feed video to pause it` in Feed, stops a tap on a feed video, or on a finished one's end screen, from opening it in Reels. Starts off. Asked for in #706.

Other changes

- HushGram now patches Instagram 455.0.0.51.72 instead of 454.0.0.54.77. Get APKMirror's (arm64-v8a) (480-640dpi) (Android 9.0+) bundle, build 386113969. Its armeabi-v7a (386113968), x86 (386113970) and x86_64 (386113971) builds are declared too.

- HushGram now patches Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 instead of 455.0.0.51.72. Get APKMirror's (arm64-v8a) (480dpi) (Android 9.0+) bundle, build 386214574. Its armeabi-v7a (386214562) and x86 (386214575) builds are declared too. Meta published no x86_64 build this time.

- HushGram now builds on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, so patching needs Morphe Manager 2.6.0 or newer. On a computer, use morphe-desktop 2.2.0 or newer.

Behind the scenes

- The push gate starts its test suites without the git settings a hook hands them. Pushed from a second worktree, the release check's test had written its stand-in tag into the real repository. Nothing reached GitHub.

- The test for `patch-for-device.ps1` caught up with the script merging a split bundle first. It now checks the merge reads the declared build's .apks and hands the CLI the merged APK.

- Three contract rules had no fixture build that breaks them, so the contract test refused the file. They keep Instagram's code from calling clear mode's `entered()` and `scrubber()` or search's `hideSection()`. Each has a failing build now.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.6.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `456.0.0.53.78`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

What was checked

11829 runtime tests passed locally. All 3168 patch tests passed too.

This one moves to Facebook 587.0.0.39.55 and needs Morphe Manager 2.6.0 or newer, so update Manager and grab the new Facebook APK before you repatch. Long posts and comments can fold at however many lines you pick, and a video you started can keep playing after you leave Facebook. Facebook's new Repost button can go too. Reels can fill a tall screen, watched stories can move to the end of the tray, the location page you get after signing in is skipped, and there's a Hushfacebook icon for the home screen and notifications. The settings come in Thai now. On the fix side, reels with a "Popular near you" line show their date again, and a post you hid stays hidden when you refresh.

- New patch, `Skip location prompts`. The full-screen page asking you to allow Location Services, the one with Skip and Continue you get after signing in, doesn't show anymore. It's on by default. Turn it off under Privacy when you do want Facebook to ask for your location. (#498)

Fixes

- `Show the post date on reels` now dates reels where Facebook says why it suggested them, like "Popular near you". In the Reels tab that reason took the whole line under the poster and pushed the date off, so those reels showed no date with the switch on. The date stays on that line now. (#496)

- `Show the post date on reels` also dates reels without sound. A silent reel has no song line, and Facebook's "Reel has no sound" label sat in its place with no date. The date goes in front of that label now, the way it does a song's. (#496)

- With `Keep the progress bar` on, a live video's chat shows up again. On Facebook 586 the switch held back more than the controls' hide timer, so the chat folded into a thin strip at the edge of the screen and only came back with Hushfacebook paused. Now it only stops that timer. (#447)

- With `Keep the progress bar` on, a video's seek bar and buttons stay up in the portrait full-screen viewer too, like on a past live or a reel's details with the panel closed. There they faded about 3 seconds after you tapped. A second tap still hides them.

- A reel on the Reels tab now reaches the bottom of the screen. With the tab bar at the top it started behind the bar but kept the height of the space under it, so the next reel peeked in at the bottom, even more with `Hide the status bar` on. With the tabs at the bottom, `Hide the status bar` and see-through bars left a black band under the reel with the next one showing below it. (#466, #494)

- With `Keep feed position on return` on, opening Facebook fresh loads the feed the way it always does. A cold start was treated like coming back to the feed, so it held an old copy of the feed instead of getting new posts, and now and then Home stayed empty until you scrolled. Coming back to Facebook, or to the feed from another screen, still keeps your place. (#493)

- `Show every reaction on comments` now covers the comments under a post you've opened and the ones shown under posts in your feed. Those rows kept showing only the top reaction even with the switch on, since Facebook picks them in two other places. (#241)

- With `Show every reaction on comments` on, a comment's count shows up to three reaction icons again. Some accounts still got just the top one beside the count, even on the row with Like and Reply. (#241)

- `Loop stories` now replays video stories too. A finished video used to sit on its last frame with a full bar while only photo stories started over, and the replay button on a held story had the same problem. (#380)

- A post you hide from the feed, with Hide post or "Hide all from" someone, stays hidden when you pull down to refresh. It used to come right back. Undo still brings it back. (#444)

- `Report a problem` leaves the "What went wrong?" box empty now, so you can type straight into it. It used to come pre-filled with two questions, and on a phone that box looked done (or wouldn't take typing at all). The questions show in it as a grey hint instead. (#488)

- `Hide the X on posts` takes the X off the Reels row in your feed too, next to its three-dot menu. The menu stays. (#389)

- Morphe Manager now treats a copy made with `Clone install under another package name` as a clone, with the Clone chip on its card. If you changed the copy's package name in that patch's options, type it in again before you repatch, because Manager won't carry the old one over. The app name you picked stays. (#474)

- With `View stories anonymously` and `Hide seen stories` on, a Highlights tile in the Stories tray that you watched all the way through leaves the tray like any other watched story. Highlights don't run on a story's 24 hours, so the check for a newer story never let them go. (#165)

- The black bar that sometimes stuck under the floating tab bar in Marketplace, even while scrolling, goes away by itself now. Marketplace lays its page out again a few times while it loads after a swipe from Home, and the bars used to give up on it until Facebook restarted. They wait a few seconds and try again instead. (#468)

- With `Rounded tab bar` on and a tab bar that doesn't slide away, the space beside the pill shows the page again instead of a white or light grey block, and the Reels tab is black around it. That happened with `Keep the tab bar on screen` on, or on accounts where Facebook keeps the bar in place, because pages there stop above the bar in a different way. (#471)

- With `Keep the progress bar` on, reels you swipe to from a feed video's full-screen player keep the bar at the bottom again. It used to sit on top of the caption there, raised for a tab bar that the player covers. (#469)

- `Hide song and effect credits` takes the song pill with its "Try it" button off the story itself now, under the poster's name. Before, it only emptied the list that opens when you tap that pill, so the pill stayed. Effect credits on that row go too. (#380)

- With `Open feed videos on their own` on, a feed video you open plays by itself again. Every so often one more video slipped in after it, because the first batch Facebook loaded for the viewer came in with the next video already in it. That batch keeps only the video you tapped now. (#457)

- A reel opened from a chat inside Facebook stays on its own with `Open feed videos on their own` on. One more reel used to play after it before the viewer stopped. (#421)

- With `Hide the status bar` on, opening a reel's comments no longer pushes the reel down, and closing them no longer leaves a black band above the Reels header for a moment. The comments bring the status bar back while they're open, and Facebook used to make room for it under them too. (#456)

- Marketplace's home feed holds back the ad rows Facebook started sending from a new kind of request, so `Hide sponsored Marketplace listings` catches them again. (#459)

- `Hide For you in search` and `Hide "People you may know" in search` also find those sections when Facebook sends them with nothing Hush could read before. With `Debug logging` on, the report lists the section names each such row carries. (#80)

- With `See-through bars` and `Hold a feed video for 2x` both on, holding a button on the Reels tab works again. Download, Like and More used to speed the reel up instead of doing their own hold, because the Reels tab looked like a feed once its pages ran under the tab bar. (#449)

- With either `Clean up Reels` switch on, the Clean mode button over a clean reel sits higher now, clear of the seek bar. A tap meant for it used to land on the bar and jump the video. (#391)

- With `Keep feed videos muted` on, a video you unmuted goes quiet again when you leave Facebook and come back. The sound used to stay on until Facebook was force stopped or left alone for a long time. A video playing in the background keeps its sound, and turning the phone's screen off and on doesn't count as leaving. (#465)

- With `Hide comment and reaction previews` on, a reel's caption stays put. A few seconds in, Facebook used to swap it for a "Name commented: ..." line. (#464)

- On accounts where Facebook puts the tab bar at the top by itself, the Reels tab no longer leaves a black strip under the tabs once you scroll, when Reels isn't the first tab. The reel runs right up to the tabs, the way it already did with `Put the tab bar at the top` on. (#390)

- With the tab bar at the top, the Reels tab's title, search and profile buttons now sit below the tabs instead of behind them. The reel itself still runs up under the bar. (#390)

- The News feed switches of `Show full post text`, `Translate posts`, `Open comments with a gesture`, `See who shared` and `Photo carousel` show up even when that's the only feed patch you picked. The page used to open only for a set list of patches, and those five weren't on it.

- `Hide Back on opened videos` now also works on a reel or video you open from search results, including the screen with "Find related reels" across its top. Before, the arrow stayed there. That header isn't marked like the Reels tab's, so it's now found by its shape, and the search results page keeps its own Back. (#388)

- `Photo carousel` lets you swipe through every photo a post brought now. Facebook's row stopped at its own limit, 12 for some accounts, so a 76-photo album ended there while tapping into the post showed all 76. (#484)

- Dragging the seek bar on a live video you opened from search results moves the video now, in the reel-style viewer and in full screen. Facebook only seeks a live video once it's marked as behind live, which its full player does while you drag but those viewers never did. Search even opens some lives as if they weren't live at all, and those now land where you let go too. Let go at the far right end and it goes back to live. (#482)

- Tapping a Threads post in your feed opens that post in Threads now, not the Threads home feed. (#385)

- `Local profile counts` changes the numbers on your profile now. Facebook draws a count and its word as two separate pieces, and the switch only looked for them together. (#488)

- `Hide the 2x popups` also hides the "2x speed" chip on feed videos for accounts where Facebook has its own hold for 2x. Holding a video there still plays it at 2x, it just doesn't put the chip over it anymore. (#343)

- With `Tap to play` on, a video you send to the picture-in-picture window with the `Picture-in-picture button` plays there again. The window used to show a frozen picture, and its play and pause did nothing. Leaving Facebook with Home already worked. (#495)

- `Hide Threads cards between reels` and `Hide post cards between reels` keep those cards off the Reels tab again. On 587 the tab loads some of its reels another way, and those went straight onto the screen past every Reels filter, so a Threads card could still show up with the switch on. `Hide sponsored reels`, `Hide AI-detected reels and videos` and `Only reels from accounts I follow` cover that way in now too. (#85, #441)

- With `Debug logging` on, the log stops repeating where the tab bar goes and that a reel runs under the top bars on every layout of the screen. Each shows once when it changes now. In one report those two lines made up nine tenths of the log and pushed out the lines that help.

Other changes

- Hushfacebook now patches Facebook 587.0.0.39.55 and no longer takes 586. On a 64-bit phone download the (arm64-v8a) (240-640dpi) (Android 11+) bundle, build 707414333, and on a 32-bit phone the (arm-v7a) (320dpi) (Android 11+) bundle, build 707414338. Facebook didn't put out a 120-640dpi build of 587, so the 240-640dpi one is the 64-bit download now. Update Facebook before you patch.

- You need Morphe Manager 2.6.0 or newer for the next release. The patches are built on Morphe patcher 2.4.0, the one Manager 2.6.0 comes with, and an older Manager won't load them. Update Manager first. On a computer, use morphe-desktop 2.2.0 or newer.

- `Tab bar height` goes up to 130 now. Past 100 the pill gets taller instead of shorter. There's barely any room above the icons, so most of the extra height goes toward the bottom of the screen. (#425)

- `Hide posts with words you choose` and `Hide link posts` work on profiles, Pages, in groups and on the Reels tab too. Group posts go in a group's own feed and in the Groups tab's feed, while search results and a post you open stay as they are. A post or reel with one of your words goes, and so does one whose words send you to a website, like the "Watch More: https://..." drama reels. Words that keep a post keep these too, and a link to Facebook itself doesn't count. (#458)

- `See-through bars` makes its frosted copy of the screen at a quarter of the size, blurs that and stretches it back over the bar. The blur takes out the fine detail anyway, so it looks the same, and phones with a weaker graphics chip have a sixteenth of the pixels to blur on every frame. (#461)

- The Playback speed row that `Playback speed in the post menu` adds now sits on the menu's first page, with Save and Report, so it's one tap away. Before, it was under More options. Turn off `Playback speed on the menu's first page` to put it back there. (#473)

- `Double tap to skip on feed videos` shows how far you jumped, +10s on the right or -10s on the left, over the side you tapped. Keep tapping and it counts up, +20s, +30s, then fades out a moment after the last tap. (#432)

- In Morphe Manager's grouped patch list, `Block promotional notifications` now sits with the ad patches, so the Interface group stays short enough to scan.

- `Hide the Follow and Subscribe links on posts` is two switches now, `Hide the Follow link on posts` and `Hide the Subscribe link on posts` under News feed, so you can keep one and drop the other. The Subscribe one covers the link next to a creator's name on posts and videos. With only the Subscribe one on, a creator's header no longer swaps its Subscribe link for a Follow one. If you had the old switch on, both start on for you, and a settings file saved before the split turns both on too. (#434)

- `Play saved videos in a row` handles the swipe itself now. Before, Facebook's swipe showed a suggested reel for a moment, then the Saved page, before your next saved video came up. Now the video slides off under your finger and the screen stays black until the next saved one opens. Swipe down to go back to the one before. A short or slow drag slides back where it was, and a side swipe is still Facebook's. New `Stay on a saved video when it ends` under it keeps a finished video on screen until you swipe, off by default. (#404)

- With `Search date range` on, the Date posted picker opens on today for both ends, so today's posts are one tap on Apply away. A range you already applied still opens the way you left it. (#279)

- `Cast button on feed videos` also puts its button on a video you've opened in Facebook's full screen player now. It sits in the top right corner, just under Facebook's close button, and Facebook's own player controls stay as they are. (#182)

Behind the scenes

- `superpack-unpack.ps1 -Desktop` unpacks Facebook's Android 9+ build on a PC with no phone or emulator attached. (#102)

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.6.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `587.0.0.39.55`. On most phones that's build `707414333`, the arm64-v8a one. Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `707414338`, the armeabi-v7a one.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 5682 tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 126 patches applied without forcing to Facebook 587.0.0.39.55, both the 64-bit and the 32-bit build, and a second build of the same commit matched this bundle entry for entry (1113 entries). I patched Facebook with this exact bundle and walked the whole app with every switch on, on a Samsung phone signed in to a full account. 88 of 127 hook families ran there, `Fold long text` and `Keep playing in the background` among them, all 23 settings pages opened in dark and in light, and Facebook didn't crash once. Android's verifier raised nothing on the patched build, the same as on Meta's own. The walk doesn't reach downloads, chats or the story viewer, so those are covered by the patch tests alone this time, and the 32-bit build was checked by its patch tests rather than on a device.

HushMessenger for Messenger 587.0.0.54.96, all 19 arm64 and armv7 builds, which needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. 98 patches. Calls can show live captions now, and unsent messages can stay in encrypted chats too. You can blur the chat list behind menus, send an Instant from your gallery, see when someone you track comes online and hide the Stories tab. Source updates don't change installed apps.

### New in this release

- `Hide Stories tab` is a new switch under Navigation. It takes the Stories tab out of the bottom bar after a restart, like the People and Notifications switches do. Refs #170.
- `Use the phone's camera app` has a new `Ask photo or video` option. The camera button asks which one you want and opens your camera app for it, so you can record videos too. Refs #168.
- `Mark as seen button` is a new switch under `View stories anonymously`. Stories you open get an eye with a slash through it while you're watching anonymously. Tap it and you show up in that story's viewer list, the way you would without the patch. The next story stays anonymous. Refs #169.
- `Send Instants from your gallery` is a new switch under Photos and videos. Tapping the shutter in Instants opens your gallery app, and the photo you pick goes out as the Instant, cut to the camera's shape. Back out of the gallery and nothing is sent. Refs #161.
- `Special contacts` is a new switch under Chat menu. Press and hold a chat with one person and tap Track this person. From then on HushMessenger writes down when they come online, go offline, type to you and change their name, using only what Messenger already shows you. Settings lists everyone you track with the last thing seen, their history, and buttons to clear it or stop tracking. You can track up to 50 people per account, and it all stays on this phone. It's experimental and starts off. Refs #163.
- `Blur behind menus` is a new switch under Theme. When you press and hold a chat, the chat list behind the menu blurs like it does on an iPhone, and so does the screen behind Messenger's other pop-up menus and sheets. It needs Android 12 or newer. Phones that can't blur behind a window (some Samsungs can't, and battery saver turns it off on others) get Messenger's own screen blurred under the menu instead. The `iPhone look` quick setup turns it on too. Experimental, and it starts off. Refs #162.
- `Live captions on calls` is a new switch under Calls. While you're on a call, what the other people say shows up as captions near the bottom of the screen, made by your phone's own speech recognition. Under the switch you pick the language they speak and the one you want to read, and if your phone can translate on the device the captions come out in your language. `Read captions aloud` reads each one in the phone's voice, and `Lower their voice while reading` turns them down while it does. It needs Android 13 or newer. It's experimental and starts off. Refs #159.
- `Row in the chat menu`, under `Keep a message log`, adds Message log to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat. Tap it and the log opens on just that chat's messages, and `All chats` takes you back to everything. It starts off. Refs #172.
- If `GmsCore support` is patched in but microG-RE isn't installed (or is turned off), the top of the HushMessenger settings says so now, since Messenger can't get notifications through Google's push service that way. `Copy setup` also gets a `Push:` line saying which push service Messenger is set up to use. Refs #173.
- The settings screen is in Turkish now. Refs #160.
- The settings screen is in Thai now, translated by MangaThatsFine. Refs #166.
- Switches that came with an update get a dot next to their name until you've seen their page, and so do their section and tab. TalkBack says "New" after the name. Refs #149.
- Material You gets a `Palette style` picker with the same choices as Android's wallpaper settings: Tonal spot, Neutral, Vibrant, Expressive, Rainbow, Fruit salad and Monochrome. A new `Light mode grays` switch tints Messenger's light-mode grays with your palette too, and white and black stay put. Refs #155.
- `Bigger chat preview` gives the preview most of the screen when you press and hold a chat, and you can scroll back through the chat right there. The menu under it stays short and scrolls. Refs #151.
- `Hide chat menu items` lets you pick what the press-and-hold menu on a chat shows. Press and hold any chat once and its items show up under the switch, ready to hide the ones you never use. Messenger always keeps at least one of its own. Refs #153.
- Two new switches under Navigation. `Hide the tab bar while scrolling` slides the bottom tab bar away as you scroll down your chats and brings it back when you scroll up. `Floating tab bar` turns on the floating style Messenger is trying out, which sits over your chats. Both take a Messenger restart. Refs #154.

### Fixes and changes

- The patches are built with Morphe patcher 2.3.0 now, the one that comes with Morphe Manager 2.5.0 and Morphe Desktop 2.1.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.5.0 or newer (or Desktop to 2.1.0) before you add this release.
- The patches now take Messenger 587.0.0.54.96 and drop 586. All 19 of 587's builds on APKMirror are covered. Refs #145.
- Videos in chat heads play like the rest of the chat now. On some phones Messenger 587 draws videos on a layer of their own, and a chat head could show that layer as a black box that stayed on screen after the chat head closed. In a chat head, or a bubble on Android 12 and newer, the video is drawn inside the chat instead. Videos in the app itself are unchanged. Refs #104.
- The switches for the menu you get when you press and hold a chat moved out of Inbox into their own Chat menu group, both in HushMessenger settings and in Morphe's patch list. Inbox had gotten long.
- The message log keeps up to 20,000 messages now, up from 5,000. Refs #172.
- `Keep unsent messages` works in encrypted chats too. When someone unsends a message there, it stays in the chat marked [unsent], as long as Messenger already showed you its words (in the chat or a notification) and hasn't restarted since. Refs #172.
- With `Spoof package version` on, parts of Messenger still saw the raised version number, like its background job check and its crash reports, because they get the app's version info in roundabout ways the patch didn't follow. Now every place Messenger reads a version number asks first whose it is. Messenger's own answers with the build you patched, and other apps keep the number Android gives. Refs #120.
- `Hide call buttons` and the call confirmation work again. Messenger 586 started wrapping a chat's audio and video call buttons in another button, and the patch was looking at the wrapper. Refs #146.
- `Ask before a call` asks on every call button now, including the ones outside a chat's top bar. A business chat and the New message screen build their own call buttons, so a tap there used to start the call right away. Refs #172.
- `Hide call buttons` takes the call buttons off business chats and the New message screen too. Those two screens build their own, so they used to stay. Refs #146, #172.
- On 586 a call crashed as it started when `Record calls` was on. The recording setup now takes its size from Messenger's own instead of 585's. Refs #146.
- The Experimental badge stays on one line. A long title used to squeeze it into a tall strip of one or two letters per line. Now it sits under the title when the two don't fit side by side. Refs #157.
- When a Meta-signed Messenger was uninstalled with its data kept, the install check told you to patch a higher version, which can't work for a build Meta signed. It points you at `Clone install` now, or at removing the leftover if you don't need its data. Refs #156.
- Patching goes faster. The code that finds where each patch goes had grown too big for Java to compile, so it ran slowly. It's split into smaller pieces now, and the slowest step takes about half as long on a computer. Refs #148, #150.
- `Android Auto messages` also works on accounts where Messenger leaves the car part out of its notifications. Messenger only adds it when a setting on Meta's side says so, and the switch turns that on. Refs #75.
- `Report a problem` reads Messenger's notification channels right again. Messenger 586 started adding a code to the end of each channel's name, so the report listed every one of them as unknown. Refs #158.
- A Root Mount over a different Messenger build now gets a warning instead of a mystery crash. Several builds share one version name, and mounting a patch made from one over another crashed chat heads. HushMessenger names the build Android has installed in a toast, under the name in settings and in `Copy setup`, so you know which one to patch. Refs #158.
- `Hide Your story when sharing` now also stops the "Chats or Your story" question some phones ask on every share. Xiaomi's share sheet groups an app's targets, and Messenger switched its story target back on at every launch, so you had to pick each time. With the switch on, sharing a photo goes straight to Chats. Refs #147.
- `Log chats that don't notify`, under `Keep a message log`, also saves messages from muted and restricted chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted, without a notification. Those chats used to stop before the log could see the message. Now they go through to the log and the notification is dropped right before it would show. Unsends still get marked, and auto reply leaves those chats alone. Refs #143.
- Patching in Morphe Manager holds less memory. One of the `Android Auto messages` lookups kept a copy of every APK it had read for as long as the patches stayed loaded, so patching a second time carried the first APK along. It lets go once it's done now. Refs #75.
- Patching does less work. The steps that look for chat heads, Material You colors and home screen shortcuts now skip code that can't match before reading it, and in testing on a computer a full patch used about a fifth less processor time. The patched app comes out exactly the same.
- Patching is quicker again. The step that finds where each switch goes used to read through Messenger's code once per switch, and now it reads it once for all of them. In testing on a computer a full patch took a little over half the processor time it did before, and the patched app is byte for byte the same.
- `GmsCore support` only tells Messenger that Google Play services is there while microG-RE is installed and turned on. It used to say yes either way, so without microG-RE Messenger kept reaching for an app that wasn't there. Now it carries on the way it does on a phone with no Play services. On Android 14 and newer, a phone without microG-RE also keeps Android's own sign-in route, so a password manager can still offer a saved login.
- A chat pinned with `Pin more chats` loses its pin mark as soon as you unpin it. The mark used to stay on the chat until Messenger restarted, even though Unpin had worked. Refs #56.

### How to update

1. Update Messenger to 587.0.0.54.96 first. On [APKMirror's 587.0.0.54.96 page](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-587-0-0-54-96-release/), take a build whose version code is 347415262, 347415267, 347415268, 347415280, 347415281, 347415284, 347415285, 347415295, 347415299, 347415301, 347415302, 347415333, 347415337, 347415348, 347415350, 347415351, 347415352, 347415354 or 347415355. APKMirror shows the code for each download, and a build posted there after this release may not be supported yet.
2. In Morphe Manager (2.5.0 or newer), open **Sources** and refresh HushMessenger. The card should say **98 patches**.
3. Patch Messenger again and install it over your current one. Your settings carry over.

Patching on a computer? `patches-0.30.0.mpp` below is the same bundle for Morphe Desktop 2.1.0 or newer. It's a patch bundle, not a Messenger APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` and its signature let you check the download, and the README says how.

### What was checked

- The full test suite, plus a patch run against all 19 Messenger 587.0.0.54.96 builds on file.
- Morphe Desktop patched and rebuilt one APK from each of the 4 build families.
- An APK patched from this exact bundle was installed on an emulator on Android API 32, signed in to Messenger. A chat, the inbox, both HushMessenger settings tabs, the message log, auto reply, Messenger's own settings, story settings and contact settings all opened, with no crashes.

Almost all of this release came from your requests. You can keep your own list of saved profiles with folders, and the glass tab bar can tick and click as you move between tabs. Settings categories now open on their own pages. The fix list below is a long one.
